title: WEF Chief Economists’ Outlook: structural headwinds and resilience
discussion_signal: The post interprets the outlook as a tension between stabilizing macro conditions and structural headwinds: geopolitical conflict, sovereign-debt limits, supply-chain flexibility, technology, and energy adaptation. It frames resilience as absorption capacity rather than a simple forecast of growth.
linked_research_question: How do geopolitical conflict, AI, energy, and fiscal constraints alter economic resilience and household exposure?
limits: The post summarizes survey expectations rather than realized outcomes
LinkedIn audience is not a representative economic sample
